name: Rao Tula Ram

context: North and central India during the anti-colonial uprising of 1857-1859.
impact: His activity demonstrates how regional rulers connected local resistance with wider rebel campaigns and cross-border support.
highlight: Rao Tula Ram was a key rebel leader from Rewari during the 1857 uprising.
